# Contributing

This is the default contributing guide for pyck-ai repositories that do not
ship their own. A repository's own `CONTRIBUTING.md` or `AGENTS.md` overrides
it. Open issues with the issue forms and pull requests with the PR template;
fill in every section they ask for.

Changes follow the [pyck-ai engineering guidelines](https://github.com/pyck-ai/guidelines):

- [Git](https://github.com/pyck-ai/guidelines/blob/main/docs/git.md): commit messages and branch names.
- [Pull requests](https://github.com/pyck-ai/guidelines/blob/main/docs/pull-requests.md): how to write and open a pull request.
- [Issues](https://github.com/pyck-ai/guidelines/blob/main/docs/issues.md): how to write, classify and triage an issue.
- [README](https://github.com/pyck-ai/guidelines/blob/main/docs/readme.md): the layout every repository README follows.
- [Code review](https://github.com/pyck-ai/guidelines/blob/main/docs/code-review.md): what reviewers look for in a diff.
